title: Cryptographically verifiable agent delegation across tool protocols
prototype_concepts: delegation receipt chained to canonical tool invocation event
procurement_implications: Prefer exportable authorization/audit records and avoid proprietary identity lock-in.
lock_in_exposure: High if identity and authorization are coupled to one hosted agent platform.
termux_relevance: Potentially high for offline/intermittent Android agent execution.
unresolved_questions: Independent validation and protocol standardization path remain unresolved.

title: Portable local agent observability becomes a systems primitive
prototype_concepts: offline-first evidence bundle with OTLP-compatible export and JSONL canonical receipt
procurement_implications: Procure components that preserve raw evidence offline and export to multiple backends.
lock_in_exposure: Moderate if telemetry persistence is centralized in a hosted vendor.
termux_relevance: Direct: ARM/Android/Termux environments benefit from offline evidence capture.
unresolved_questions: Measure resource overhead on real Android/Termux workloads.

title: Multi-agent manager policy becomes a measurable optimization layer
prototype_concepts: bounded manager tournament with identical tasks and replayable evidence
procurement_implications: Buy evaluation infrastructure only if it can ingest/export the canonical evidence contract.
lock_in_exposure: Moderate when evaluation history cannot be exported.
termux_relevance: High for deciding when to use local agents, cloud agents, or human escalation.
unresolved_questions: Transferability to ARM/Android and long-horizon coding tasks.

title: Deterministic simulation isolates manager/orchestration quality from worker noise
prototype_concepts: simulation preflight before live manager tournament
procurement_implications: Prefer evaluation infrastructure that separates orchestration policy evidence from worker/model evidence and exports replayable results.
lock_in_exposure: Moderate if benchmark definitions or scores are trapped in a hosted evaluation platform.
termux_relevance: High for reducing cost of manager-policy experiments before Android/cloud execution.
unresolved_questions: Validate coding-task transfer and local reproducibility.

title: MCP tool admission should become an auditable security boundary
prototype_concepts: MCP admission receipt chained to canonical tool invocation event
procurement_implications: Require exportable tool schemas, authorization state, provenance, and raw invocation evidence before adopting hosted MCP gateways.
lock_in_exposure: High if tool identity, authorization, and evidence are coupled to one hosted gateway.
termux_relevance: High for Android/Termux private MCP hubs and constrained tool execution.
unresolved_questions: Which protocol-level identity/delegation fields should become stable contract inputs?

title: ARM/Android inference procurement is shifting toward memory, thermal, energy, and runtime evidence
prototype_concepts: same-model Android/ARM cohort with pinned hashes and evidence receipts
procurement_implications: Prefer runtimes with local/offline operation, open model formats, CPU fallback, and exportable benchmark evidence.
lock_in_exposure: Moderate when accelerator APIs or hosted model services become mandatory.
termux_relevance: Direct: establishes the measurement contract for the mobile-first execution target.
unresolved_questions: Determine first device matrix and energy proxy.

title: Open agent runtimes are becoming an enforceable governance boundary
prototype_concepts: runtime admission receipt linked to agent/tool spans
policy decision export alongside execution evidence
procurement_implications: Require external enforcement, exportable audit evidence, and portable policy artifacts before adopting hosted agent governance.
lock_in_exposure: Moderate-to-high if runtime policy and evidence are coupled to one infrastructure provider.
termux_relevance: High conceptually; direct Android/Termux implementation remains to be validated.
unresolved_questions: Portability to non-NVIDIA hosts and constrained Android execution.

title: MCP observability semantics are evolving faster than a safe canonical schema should
prototype_concepts: version-aware MCP adapter that emits only stable subset into canonical records
procurement_implications: Avoid locking canonical evidence to development-status semantic conventions; require raw export and adapter versioning.
lock_in_exposure: Low at the standard layer but higher if a hosted backend becomes the only interpretation surface.
termux_relevance: High because lightweight schema-only consumption is feasible even when full exporters are not.
unresolved_questions: Which attributes remain stable across MCP protocol versions and durable execution patterns?

title: Memory bandwidth and advanced packaging remain strategic inference bottlenecks
prototype_concepts: memory/thermal/energy evidence contract across ARM and remote inference cohorts
procurement_implications: Include memory and energy metrics in accelerator/runtime procurement; do not optimize on token throughput alone.
lock_in_exposure: Moderate where proprietary accelerator APIs become mandatory.
termux_relevance: High for deciding when local ARM inference is viable versus remote escalation.
unresolved_questions: Which device-level measurements best approximate energy and memory bottlenecks on Termux?
